name: eggd_cgp-cnvkit-pon
title: eggd_cgp-cnvkit-pon
summary: Builds a CNVkit panel-of-normals (PoN) reference from per-sample coverage files produced by eggd_cgp-cnvkit-coverage. Output reference.cnn is the input to eggd_cgp-cnvkit-batch.

inputSpec.name: coverage_files
inputSpec.label: Per-sample coverage files (.targetcoverage.cnn)
inputSpec.help: One .targetcoverage.cnn file per sample, produced by eggd_cgp-cnvkit-coverage. Minimum 10 files recommended; 20+ preferred for a stable PoN median. All files must have been generated with the same BED and target_avg_size settings.

inputSpec.name: pon_name
inputSpec.label: Output reference filename stem (no extension)
inputSpec.help: Base name for the output .cnn reference file. Default: cgp_cnvkit_reference.

inputSpec.name: fasta
inputSpec.label: Reference genome FASTA (.fasta.gz, bgzf-compressed)
inputSpec.help: When supplied, cnvkit.py reference annotates each interval with GC content and RepeatMasker fraction, enabling GC-bias correction in downstream fix steps. The FASTA chromosome naming must match the BED/BAM naming (chr-prefix for chr-prefix BAMs). Requires fasta_fai and fasta_gzi to be supplied alongside.

inputSpec.name: fasta_fai
inputSpec.label: FASTA index (.fasta.gz.fai)
inputSpec.help: samtools .fai index for the bgzf-compressed FASTA. Required when fasta is supplied.

inputSpec.name: fasta_gzi
inputSpec.label: FASTA bgzf block index (.fasta.gz.gzi)
inputSpec.help: bgzf block index (.gzi) for the bgzf-compressed FASTA. Required when fasta is supplied.

inputSpec.name: diploid_parx_genome
inputSpec.label: PAR-aware genome build for --diploid-parx-genome
inputSpec.help: Passed to `cnvkit.py reference` and `cnvkit.py sex` as `--diploid-parx-genome <value>`, which treats the named genome build's chrX pseudoautosomal region (PAR1/PAR2) as autosomal instead of applying the male/female chrX offset there. Example: grch38. Leave blank to disable (CNVkit's pre-PARX chrX handling).

inputSpec.name: gc_clip_min
inputSpec.label: Lower bound for gc column clipping
inputSpec.help: Only applied when fasta is supplied. Reference intervals with gc below this value have their gc column clipped to this value (not dropped), so `fix`'s GC-bias masking (which excludes bins with gc outside [0.3, 0.7] by default) keeps them while still GC-correcting them at the bound. Values are otherwise unchanged (log2/depth/spread untouched). Must be strictly less than gc_clip_max. Omit fasta to disable clipping entirely (there is no gc column to clip).

inputSpec.name: gc_clip_max
inputSpec.label: Upper bound for gc column clipping
inputSpec.help: Only applied when fasta is supplied. Reference intervals with gc above this value have their gc column clipped to this value (not dropped). See gc_clip_min.

outputSpec.name: cn_reference
outputSpec.label: CNVkit PoN reference (.cnn)
outputSpec.help: Pooled PoN reference file encoding per-interval median and spread across all input samples. Pass to eggd_cgp-cnvkit-batch as cn_reference.

outputSpec.name: reference_stats
outputSpec.label: Reference summary statistics (.tsv)
outputSpec.help: TSV of summary metrics: n_intervals, log2_mean, log2_median, log2_stdev, depth_median, n_samples. Use to verify the PoN was built correctly.

outputSpec.name: pon_member_sex
outputSpec.label: PoN member sex check (.tsv)
outputSpec.help: cnvkit.py sex output (sample, sex, X_logratio, Y_logratio) for every input coverage file, computed with the same --diploid-parx-genome setting as the reference build. Cross-check against each member's LIMS sex to flag members whose inferred sex looks wrong before trusting the PoN's chrX/chrY handling; this does not gate the build.
